result.markdown:
The best payroll software for a small business depends on where your business operates, how many employees you have, and whether you want payroll, tax compliance and HR all handled in one place.

**My recommendation: Gusto is a strong all-round choice for US small businesses.** However, if your business is in Australia, I would look at Australian payroll platforms instead, because local tax, superannuation and Single Touch Payroll (STP) compliance are essential.

## My recommendation for an Australian small business

| Your situation | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| Already use Xero | Xero Payroll |
| Want standalone payroll for 1–4 employees | MYOB Payroll Only |
| Need award interpretation and rostering | Employment Hero |
| Want low-cost payroll for a micro business | Payroller |
| Want payroll and workforce scheduling together | Deputy or Microkeeper |


Australian payroll software needs to handle STP Phase 2, PAYG withholding and superannuation obligations. Payday Super requirements also make it important to check how the platform processes super payments. search_results.description: The article reviews payroll platforms for small businesses in 2026, assessing features, pricing, usability, integrations, documentation, and customer support. Gusto is its top dependable choice, combining full-service payroll, tax compliance, benefits, and accounting integrations. Xero stands out for accounting and app integrations, while QuickBooks is recommended for mobile payroll. Paychex suits businesses seeking outsourced HR and benefits administration; Rippling offers flexible, scalable HR, payroll, IT, and expense tools. Remote Payroll supports international hiring and compliance, and Zoho People bundles payroll with a broad HR and business ecosystem. Other picks include PeopleHR for UK SMEs, Patriot Payroll for straightforward value, BambooHR for ease of use, Hourly for time tracking and workers’ compensation, 1st Money for small UK businesses (free for fewer than 10 employees), Breathe HR for simplified HR, and Employment Hero for advanced features. The article also highlights ADP’s payroll and HR services. It advises choosing software based on business size and required features, prioritizing compliance, integrations, transparent pricing, employee self-service, and responsive support.
